changelog:
Initial release of Thoth Standard — Auto-Documentation Engine.

- Scans an entire project directory to auto-generate README, API reference, and a usage guide.
- Supports multiple code and meta file types for comprehensive documentation.
- Requires LICENSE_KEY and PROJECT_PATH environment variables to run.
- Outputs all documentation as markdown files (README.md, API_REFERENCE.md, USAGE_GUIDE.md) in a specified directory.
- Includes project validation, code symbol extraction, and detailed structure/usage breakdowns.
summary: Thoth Standard -- Auto-Documentation Engine. Reads your entire project and generates README, API reference, and usage guide. Saved to .md files.
